schema_version: "0.2.16"
definitions:

fixOptions.description: Apply the admitted safe canonical-format recipe: preview with lekalo fix LEK-FORMAT-001 --dry-run first, then --apply --expect-plan <id>. The recipe refuses comment loss and proves normalized Model and IR equality.

explanations.rationale: It matters because formatting diffs are the noisiest review artifacts; the canonical form plus the equality proof keep format-only changes provably semantic-free.
rootCauses: a document was edited outside the canonical formatter
a formatter run would lose comments or change the compiled IR
the formatter policy was changed without reformatting

severityProfile.waiverPolicy: Not waivable: canonical formatting is the identity of a document.

targetNotes.note: Target-neutral: formatting owns Model documents only.

explanations.title: Canonical formatting or formatting-service failure
